name: PURE Workplace - Topeka KS
old_description: Since 1996, PURE has been transforming workspaces that inspire teams and engage people for how they want to work today in Workplace, Higher Education, Government, Healthcare, Hospitality and Senior Living environments.
about:
PURE Workplace Solutions was founded in 1996 in Topeka, Kansas, as a full-service commercial interiors firm. The company operates regionally across Kansas and Missouri and maintains a national presence through offices in Kansas City, Wichita, Topeka, and Chicago.

As an authorized MillerKnoll dealer, PURE provides office furniture, interior design, and architectural products from brands such as Herman Miller, Knoll, NaughtOne, Muuto, DatesWeiser, Geiger, HON, Kimball, National, SitOnIt, Global, and OFS. Its services encompass space planning and design, product specification and procurement, installation and relocation, and project management. Manufacturer-trained and certified crews handle installations, backed by a nationwide network of union and non-union installers. Project managers coordinate delivery schedules with clients, general contractors, and on-site trades to align with construction timelines.

The firm serves workplace, higher education, government, healthcare, hospitality, and senior living environments. Clients include marketing agency Barkley and technology partner Barrier Technologies, along with public-sector buyers through OMNIA Partners, which provides access to more than 410,000 members across over 35 industries.

PURE emphasizes a customer-centric approach, stating that its focus is to deliver solutions that make clients and their teams happy with the results.

name: Pac/Rim Medical Technology & Supplies Corporation
old_description: Pac/Rim Medical Technology & Supplies was founded on the principle of being the best source for medical technology and supplies throughout the Hawaiian Islands. We adhere to a dedication to excellence that has kept us at the top of the industry year after year. Our reputation is built on the quality of our merchandise and the level of service we provide to each client.
about:
Pac/Rim Medical Technology & Supplies Corporation was founded in 1988 in Aiea, Hawaii, as a locally owned distributor of medical technology and supplies for the Hawaiian Islands.

The company distributes a wide selection of laboratory, medical, and infection control products, as well as imaging devices and technical equipment. It is a certified distributor of BD products, offering BD Vacutainer blood collection systems, BD Veritor rapid testing analyzers for COVID-19, flu, and RSV, and Olympus microscope systems, cameras, and software. The firm also supplies personal protective equipment and general PPE such as masks and gloves. Operating from facilities in Aiea and Honolulu, the company stocks inventory locally and can procure hard-to-find equipment on short notice.

Pac/Rim serves clinical laboratories, physicians' offices, hospitals, research institutions, and businesses requiring diagnostic testing. Its BD Veritor analyzers bring hospital-grade testing to businesses, while BD Vacutainer products are used by laboratories and phlebotomists to improve workflow. Olympus imaging systems support routine microscopy in research and clinical settings.

The company emphasizes its dedication to excellence, built on product quality and service level. It differentiates itself through local ownership and stocking, over 30 years of industry experience, a knowledgeable staff, competitive pricing, and the ability to fulfill orders quickly, including large, small, and hard-to-find items.

name: Pacific Jobbers Warehouse Inc
old_description: Auto parts knowledge is a core principle at Pacific Jobbers Warehouse with six counter salespeople that have a combined 200 years of auto parts experience to help professional technicians find the right parts. Another core principle is consistent delivery service which is accomplished with 25 delivery vehicles that are constantly on the move fulfilling orders and taking care of our auto service industry partners. Pacific Jobbers Warehouse and Maui Auto Parts are the only home grown, employee-owned auto parts provider in Hawaii. Since 1986, customer service has always been a top priority which has made us a leader in the automotive industry and the preferred auto parts supplier by professional technicians.
about:
Pacific Jobbers Warehouse began in 1986 on Kahai Street in Honolulu’s Kalihi Kai district when Tetsuji Ideta, Melvin Sasaki, and a group of automotive industry veterans pooled their experience to launch a single-brand operation selling Bendix brakes. The company is employee-owned and has remained locally rooted since its founding.

Today the business distributes original-equipment and name-brand auto parts across more than 90 product lines, including AC Delco, Motorcraft, Mopar, Denso, NGK, Aisin, Advics, Akebono, Bosch, Moog, Monroe, Wix, Timken, Centric, Gates, and Trico. Inventory spans ignition, filtration, belts, cooling, fuel, emission, electrical, HVAC, brakes, chassis, steering, exhaust, clutch, tire, wheel, drivetrain, engine, vision, and fluid categories. A staff of roughly 80 operates from a Honolulu facility and a Maui branch (added through a 2011 merger with Aloha Otto Parts), supported by 25 delivery vehicles and six counter specialists who collectively hold 200 years of parts knowledge.

The company serves professional technicians and auto-service shops throughout Hawaii via commercial accounts and an online ordering platform. Its customer base includes independent repair facilities, dealership service departments, and fleet operators who rely on consistent daily delivery.

Management emphasizes two differentiators: the depth of its counter expertise and a fleet that keeps parts moving island-wide. Leadership also notes that Pacific Jobbers Warehouse and its Maui Auto Parts division are the only home-grown, employee-owned auto-parts distributor in the state, a position that grants them privileged access to top OEM brands.

name: Pacific Packaging Industries
old_description: Pacific Packaging was founded in 1947 with a single customer- a local potato farm. With Pacific Packaging's focus on personal attention, great products at a competitive price and top-notch customer service, the company continued to grow. Today, Pacific Packaging Industries is a global operation with customers around the world.
about:
Pacific Packaging Industries was founded in 1947 in Portland, Oregon, beginning with a single customer—a local potato farm. The company has since grown into a global operation serving customers worldwide.

The company manufactures and distributes custom flexible packaging, specializing in printed woven and non-woven polypropylene bags. Its capabilities include a full-service printing and art department, high-quality proofing services, and the design of custom packaging solutions. Product lines encompass BOPP films, printed woven polypropylene, printed burlap, stock packaging, bulk bags, and earthbag building systems.

Pacific Packaging serves a range of industries, including food packaging, pet food and related products, retail packaging, agricultural feed and seed, and landscaping products. The company emphasizes personal attention to each customer's packaging needs.

The firm differentiates itself through personal attention, a wide variety of innovative packaging materials and features, creative full-service printing and art department, endless package design possibilities, and high-quality proofing services.

about:
Pacific Rim Packaging, Inc. was founded in 1994 in Aiea, Hawaii. The company began as a local packaging supplier serving the Hawaiian islands and the broader Pacific Rim region.

The firm acts as a packaging solutions provider, offering a range that includes corrugated boxes, folding cartons, temperature-controlled packaging, protective packaging, plastic bags, paper bags, flexible films, and retail packaging. Production is handled by a network of manufacturing partners that employ flexographic, lithographic, and rotogravure printing, along with UV coating, foil stamping, and embossing. Pacific Rim Packaging operates a warehouse where all incoming goods are inspected before delivery.

Its customer base spans food and beverage, seafood processing, agriculture, retail, and wholesale sectors. Long‑term clients cited by the company include Big Island Bees, HPC Foods, and True World Foods, all of which rely on the supplier for perishable‑goods packaging and branded retail containers.

The business was built on a consultative selling approach and a commitment to 'service with aloha.' name: Pacific West America
old_description: Pacific West America is a precision manufacturing company specializing in CNC machining and Swiss screw machining of small, intricate parts for the electronics and defense industries. Also offers PCB fabrication and assembly services.
about:
Pacific West America operates from Calabasas, California, where it was founded in 1995. The privately held company has grown to a staff of 50 to 99 employees, serving as a precision manufacturing partner for original equipment manufacturers and tier-one suppliers.

The shop focuses on CNC machining and Swiss-type screw machining, producing small, intricate components from bar stock and billet. In addition to machining, the facility runs PCB fabrication and assembly lines, turning out bare boards, populated assemblies, and membrane-switch panels. The combined capability lets customers consolidate machined housings, interconnects, and electronics under one roof.

Primary markets include the electronics, defense, and medical-device sectors. Programs range from ruggedized connector bodies and sensor housings for defense platforms to implantable-device components and diagnostic-instrument sub-assemblies for medical OEMs.

The company positions its differentiation on the integration of precision machining with full-spectrum PCB services, enabling shorter lead times and single-source accountability for complex electromechanical assemblies.

name: Pack Manufacturing Co
old_description: Pack Manufacturing has been building custom material handling solutions for over 25 years. Since 1994, Pack Mfg. has been instilled with the same values of family, a strong work ethic, and taking pride in your work that have formed the hallmark of this industry-leading business. As you can imagine, Pack Mfg., and the industry as a whole, has experienced an explosion in growth since 1994. The Pack Manufacturing business model of excellent craftsmanship customized for the customer has stood the test of time. Through all the changing seasons, Pack Manufacturing has adapted and grown thanks to a strong emphasis on innovation and embracing technology. As we head into the future, Pack Manufacturing is singularly placed to lead the industry into the next 25 years.
about:
Pack Manufacturing Co. operates from McMinnville, Tennessee, where it was founded in 1994. The company is owned by James and Leisha Brooks, who bought out the remaining shareholders after James had spent two decades at the helm. The business began as a niche provider of custom material handling equipment and has since expanded multiple times while retaining its original family-oriented values.

The company designs and builds custom material handling systems for horticultural and industrial applications. Its product lines include mixers, potting machines, flat fillers, conveyors, bale breakers, and watering systems, all of which can be integrated into fully automated production lines. Pack Manufacturing handles metal fabrication, welding, and automation integration in-house, tailoring each unit to the customer's facility dimensions and operational tolerances. The facility has grown through several expansions over 25 years, though specific square footage and headcount are not disclosed.

Pack Manufacturing serves agriculture, horticulture, greenhouse, nursery, lumber, mixing, assembly line, mining, compounding, and automotive sectors. Customers range from growers needing media blending and tray filling to industrial operations requiring custom conveying and processing lines. The company emphasizes a consultative approach, helping clients identify the right automation solution rather than pushing standardized equipment.

The founders stress durability and return on investment as key differentiators. Equipment features such as solid construction, sealed bearings, self-tracking belts, and direct-drive gearboxes are intended to minimize downtime.

about:
Packaging & More, Inc. is based in Central Falls, Rhode Island. The company has been locally owned and operated since 1993. The Fonseca family has roots in the area: Tony Fonseca, a U.S. Navy veteran of the Vietnam War, and his wife Dianne have lived in nearby Smithfield since 1975. Their sons, Tony and Vincent, joined the business full time in 2005.

The company operates as a food service packaging distributor, supplying independent grocers, bakeries, and restaurants across southern New England. It emphasizes a friendly, courteous operation with a focus on premium product lines, competitive delivered pricing, and customer service. The firm also promotes environmentally conscious practices, including fuel-efficient delivery vehicles and affordable green product options.

Customers include independent grocery stores, bakeries, and restaurants in Rhode Island, Massachusetts, and Connecticut. The distributor positions itself as a partner that helps these operators compete on pricing and quality with larger corporations.

The company was founded to provide independent food service operators with a reliable, local source for packaging, differentiating itself through personal service, green initiatives, and a family-owned, veteran-led structure.

name: Pahlke Steel
old_description: Formerly Pahlke Pipe & Rod, Pahlke Steel is a family owned and operated business that has been in existence since 1991 selling used well pipe and various livestock products. Pahlke Steel added new steel to its product line in May of 2012, offering a wide variety of steel products including Angle, Flats, Beams, Channels, Pipe, Sheet and Plate.
about:
Pahlke Steel, based in Bismarck, North Dakota, traces its roots to 1991 when it began as Pahlke Pipe & Rod, a family-owned operation selling used well pipe and livestock products. The company expanded into new steel products in May 2012, adding structural shapes such as angle, flats, beams, and channels, as well as pipe, sheet, and plate.

Today the business operates as a steel service center and distributor, stocking a broad range of carbon steel, aluminum, stainless, and galvanized products including angle, beams, channels, pipe, sheet, and plate. It also carries fasteners (bolts, nuts, washers, threaded rod, anchors), tools (including DeWALT), industrial supplies (abrasives, sealants, cutting products, safety supplies), and used pipe. The company offers local delivery and can provide material test reports upon request.

Its customer base spans contractors, manufacturers, farms, ranches, and other businesses throughout the Bismarck region and surrounding areas. The company emphasizes a large in-stock inventory to keep projects moving without long lead times.

Pahlke Steel differentiates itself through its local presence, extensive stock, fast and dependable service, delivery availability, and the ability to furnish material test reports for traceability.

name: Panda Apparel LLC
old_description: We have been screen printing apparel since 2007.  Screen printing – often referred to as “silkscreen,” is the most commonly ordered of our decorating methods. Screen printing is a printmaking technique used to print images on t-shirts, sweatshirts, etc. This technique is often preferred over other processes such as dye sublimation or inkjet printing because of its low cost and ability to print on many types of products.
about:
Panda Apparel LLC operates as Panda Imprinting & Graphics from a 11,500-square-foot production facility in Springfield, New Jersey. The company was founded in 2007 by Scott and Donna Marino, who brought over 65 years of combined apparel industry experience to the venture. The Marino-owned business began as a screen-printing shop and has since expanded into a full-service decoration house with a second retail location in Cranford, NJ.

The shop provides custom apparel decoration through screen printing, embroidery, direct digital printing, and vinyl heat sealing. All production is kept in-house, allowing the team to manage quality and deadlines across runs that range from single-piece orders to large commercial volumes. The facility houses dedicated specialists in graphic art, production scheduling, screen printing, embroidery, packaging, and logistics, and the company also powers Varsity Central, an online platform for spirit wear and varsity jackets.

Clients include local schools, small businesses, national retailers, and Fortune 500 companies, as well as landscapers, contractors, civic groups, non-profits, sports teams, Greek organizations, and event planners for marathons, bridal parties, and family reunions. The company offers group discounts and company-store programs for recurring uniform needs.

Panda Imprinting emphasizes its in-house equipment investment and free virtual proofs as key differentiators, stating that internal production control enables fast, economical turnaround without hidden screen charges. The business was started to deliver high-quality custom products with competitive pricing and unmatched service to a diverse client base.
